quotes.text: Happiness must be taken, and I will take mine.
quotes.author: Lord Shen

quotes.text: Sometimes we do the wrong things for the good reasons.
quotes.author: Mr. Ping

quotes.text: Change is part of the journey.
quotes.author: Zhen

quotes.text: Finally, a worthy opponent! Our battle will be legendary!
quotes.author: Tai Lung

quotes.text: You are ready. I've never been more sure of anything.
quotes.author: Po

quotes.text: You gotta let go of that stuff from the past because it just doesn't matter. The only thing that matters is what you choose to be now.
quotes.author: Po

quotes.text: There's no charge for awesomeness... or attractiveness.
quotes.author: Po

quotes.text: Who are you? ... I've been asking the same question. Am I the son of a panda? The son of a goose? A student? A teacher? Turns out, I'm all of them.
quotes.author: Po

quotes.text: The dead exist in the past, and I must tend to the future.
quotes.author: Lord Shen
